import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild, ElementRef, } from '@angular/core'; import { ChatService } from '../../../services/chat.service'; import { ChatMessage } from '../../../models/chat.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-user-chat', templateUrl: './user-chat.component.html', styleUrls: ['./user-chat.component.css'], }) export class UserChatComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy { @ViewChild('messageContainer') messageContainer!: ElementRef; currentUser: string = ''; messages: ChatMessage[] = []; newMessage: string = ''; isLoading: boolean = false; showBot: boolean = false; botQuestion: string = ''; botMessages: { text: string; isUser: boolean }[] = []; constructor(private chatService: ChatService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.currentUser = localStorage.getItem('username') || 'Guest'; if (this.currentUser !== 'Guest') { this.connectToChat(); this.loadChatHistory(); this.initBot(); } } initBot(): void { this.botMessages.push({ text: '🤖 Hello! I am QuickMart Assistant. How can I help you today?', isUser: false, }); } connectToChat(): void { this.chatService.connect(this.currentUser).subscribe({ next: (message) => { if (message.sender === 'admin' || message.sender === 'support') { this.messages.push(message); this.playNotification(); this.scrollToBottom(); } }, error: (err) => console.error('WebSocket error:', err), }); } loadChatHistory(): void { this.isLoading = true; this.chatService.getChatHistory(this.currentUser, 'admin').subscribe({ next: (messages) => { this.messages = messages; this.isLoading = false; this.scrollToBottom(); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error loading chat history:', err); this.isLoading = false; }, }); } sendMessage(): void { if (!this.newMessage.trim()) return; const message: ChatMessage = { sender: this.currentUser, receiver: 'admin', message: this.newMessage, messageType: 'TEXT', timestamp: new Date(), isRead: false, }; this.chatService.sendMessage(message); this.messages.push(message); this.newMessage = ''; this.scrollToBottom(); } askBot(): void { if (!this.botQuestion.trim()) return; this.botMessages.push({ text: this.botQuestion, isUser: true }); this.chatService.getBotResponse(this.botQuestion).subscribe({ next: (response) => { this.botMessages.push({ text: response.message, isUser: false }); this.botQuestion = ''; }, error: (err) => console.error('Bot error:', err), }); } toggleBot(): void { this.showBot = !this.showBot; } playNotification(): void { const audio = new Audio('/assets/notification.mp3'); audio.play().catch((e) => console.log('Audio play failed')); } scrollToBottom(): void { setTimeout(() => { if (this.messageContainer) { this.messageContainer.nativeElement.scrollTop = this.messageContainer.nativeElement.scrollHeight; } }, 100); } formatTime(date: Date): string { return new Date(date).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', }); } ngOnDestroy(): void { this.chatService.disconnect(); } }
